items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Well, Ponce talked about playing with us at a ballpark up there, national ballpark.

ctx.x: Did you ever play many picnics around here? Oh, yeah.

Picnics. I used to play for the Dixie Cottage every Sunday on the lake. I used to play on the Tuskehanna. Go over in Mandeville. On the boat. Yeah, we used to have that job. And the Dixie Cottage, that was us job regularly. Every Sunday. You couldn't get off from them people. Because when it wouldn't be one, it'd be somebody else. Then they had to get the same band. We played there for years and years. Well, Ponce talked about playing with us at a ballpark up there, national ballpark. Oh, yeah. We used to play…
